name: firestore-rules-structure
description: firestore.rules uses explicit per-collection owner-scoped matches (no wildcard) with shape validation on wallet writes
body: firestore.rules has NO permissive wildcard match — it enumerates each collection under /users/{userId} with an isOwner() helper, because Firestore rules are OR-ed and a wildcard would override validated rules. Pattern for adding a new collection (e.g. tasks): add a `match /<name>/{docId}` block; for validated ones split `allow read, delete: if isOwner()` from `allow create, update: if isOwner() && <shape checks>` so deletes (request.resource==null) aren't blocked. On update, request.resource.data is the merged full doc so partial updates still satisfy shape checks. Unlisted collections default-deny. Deploy: firebase deploy --only firestore:rules.
